section_or_page: §4.1 Holding the Model Fixed (HTML v1, 本文)
excerpt: For claude-3-5-sonnet, which appears with nine scaffolds, the range is 168 to 317 — 149 instances, or 29.8pp. For claude-4-sonnet (eight scaffolds) it is 99 instances; for gpt-4o (six) it is 78. Symmetrically, the observed within-scaffold model range has a median of 60 instances (12.0pp). For scale, the entire spread of the top thirty submissions is 8.8pp.
interpretation: 〔証拠段階 C〕観測データ。abstract の 29.8pp は単一モデル（claude-3-5-sonnet, 9 scaffold）の値で、モデル内 scaffold 範囲の中央値は 15.6pp（同節：『the observed within-model scaffold range has a median of 78 instances (15.6pp)』）。abstract の『reach 29.8』は最大値であり、代表値ではない。同節の additive fit では scaffold 効果範囲 37.6pp、model 効果範囲 47.9pp、比 0.78（R²=0.989）。論文は『The reading is not that scaffolds matter more than models, but that the fitted ranges are of the same order.』と限定し、『not causal effects or fractions of variance explained』と明記。

section_or_page: §4.1 Pass Rate, Table 2 (HTML v1, 本文)
excerpt: Within a model, the harness range is 2–8 pp; across models within a harness it is 4–10 pp.
interpretation: 〔証拠段階 B〕本文 Table 2（Goose 48/38%、OpenCode 50/46%、OpenHands-SDK 50/46%、Qwen/MiniMax の 2 モデル、n=50 各セル）と整合。abstract の『0–8 pp』の下限 0 は OpenCode vs OpenHands-SDK の差に相当。モデル数は 2 のみ。95% CI は各セルで約 ±14pp（例：Goose Qwen [34, 62]）で、本文自身が『most pairwise pass-rate differences are not statistically distinguishable from zero』と述べる。注意：本文 Table 4（失敗カテゴリ別の solved 数）は Table 2 と 1–2 件ずれる（Goose Qwen 23 vs 24、Goose MiniMax 17 vs 19、OpenCode MiniMax 22 vs 23、OpenHands MiniMax 21 vs 23）。Table 2 と Table 5 の合計（Goose 43、OpenCode 48、OpenHands 48）は一致。Table 4 からは harness 差が 10pp と計算されるため、Table 4 は検算不一致として扱う。
